name: approval_limit_validator
description: Use this tool to check if an invoice's net amount strictly complies with the financial approval limit of the specific employee who approved it in the system logs.
schema: [{"id":1,"property":"net_amount","type":"number","description":"The net invoice amount from the Supplier_Invoices table","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"amount_limit","type":"number","description":"The financial approval limit of the employee from the Approval_Logs table","required":true},{"id":3,"property":"approver_name","type":"string","description":"The name of the person who approved the transaction from the Approval_Logs table","required":true}]
